title: Bern-Barcelona EEG database: focal and nonfocal intracranial EEG signal pairs (Andrzejak, Schindler & Rummel 2012)
description: The Bern-Barcelona EEG database contains 7500 pairs of intracranial EEG signals (3750 focal and 3750 non-focal), each 20 s long and sampled at 512 Hz, drawn from five patients with pharmacoresistant temporal lobe epilepsy. Signals were band-pass filtered and re-referenced by the original authors, and pairs were selected from seizure-free intervals. This BIDS version is a lossless repackaging of the source text files into BrainVision format. Patient identity is not retained, so all runs are pooled under a single pseudo-subject.
methods_description: Long-term intracranial strip and depth electrode recordings were made in five epilepsy surgery candidates at the University of Bern. The data were band-pass filtered at 0.5-150 Hz (zero-phase Butterworth), down-sampled to 512 Hz where needed, and re-referenced to the median of artifact-free channels. Focal channels were defined as those showing the first ictal changes on visual inspection. 20-s windows of neighbouring channel pairs were randomly sampled from seizure-free periods. Values were converted from text to float32 BrainVision files without any alteration.
